van_de.mo_ta: Truong `physical_attempts` cua manifest dem MOI lan provider callable duoc goi, KE CA nhanh `n == 0` von tra thang raw candidate LICH SU doc tu artifact va KHONG phat mot API request nao.

logical_application_calls.dinh_nghia: So THAO TAC ung dung LLM ma phep do co y thuc hien (o day: mot vong sua).

physical_api_attempts.dinh_nghia: So REQUEST that su roi tien trinh di toi provider, KE CA retry cua transport va ke ca request tra ve loi.
physical_api_attempts.dem_o_dau: PHAI dem SAU nhanh tra raw lich su. Bang chung doi chieu: telemetry `calls`.
physical_api_attempts.luu_y: Trong mot luot chay co retry transport, gia tri nay LON HON logical_application_calls. Day khong phai loi — hai truong do hai thu khac nhau.

candidate_attempts.dinh_nghia: So UNG VIEN chuong trinh ma vong lap da xu ly, ke ca ung vien nap tu artifact.

attempt 1 — candidate SUA, ket qua cua 1 API request, 3123 token
